text:
Maya: Hey team — need to swap out of EU primary for my 12:00–20:00 UTC shift. family emergency. Can someone take primary for the 6 hours? I can stay secondary if needed. @Liam @Sophia

Liam: I can cover 12:00–16:00 UTC (first half). Sophia, can you take 16:00–20:00? :thumbsup:

Sophia: I can do 16:00–20:00. Quick Q — do we need to rotate the pager or is the /oncall transfer enough? Also any hot runbook pointers?

oncall-bot: schedule-check: Maya is PRIMARY for 12:00-18:00 UTC today. Next rotation at 18:00. To change primary, use `/oncall transfer <from> <to>`. See: https://redwood.ops/oncall (runbook & audit)

Maya: thanks. Liam — can you run the transfer at 11:55 UTC? I may have to step away at 12:05. I'll drop handoff notes below.

Liam: yep I'll run it. Checklist for transfer: 1) transfer pager 2) verify warm GPU pools in eu-west 3) confirm canary routing and traffic weights. Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood/sys/prim-handoff

Maya: handoff notes:
- active incident: none
- canary latencies: within baseline (p50/p95 ok)
- recent deploy tag: release-2026-03-14b
- watch services: inference-gateway, kv-cache, embedding-queue
- quick commands:
```
# check gateway pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway
# redis health
redis-cli -h redis.prod.cluster INFO | grep used_memory
```
- customers to watch: @acme-platform (heavy embed users in EU)

Sophia: noted. Liam do you want me to take over at 16:00? If traffic spikes near 15:50 we should extend the relay.

Liam: agreed. I'll run transfer at 11:55 and post confirmation. Also planning to add a temporary alert throttle for noisy metric `embed-queue-depth` if it starts flapping.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: release-2026-03-14b by ci/cd @jen at 2026-03-14T10:42Z — all checks passed, no failed jobs.

Maya: Thanks all. If anyone needs VPC keys or HSM access, ping eng-infra; I'll PM any token rotation notes before I step away.

Liam: transfer done: `/oncall transfer Maya -> Liam` at 11:55 UTC — primary is now Liam. Pager reassigned and confirmed. :white_check_mark:

Sophia: picking up second half handover. Liam, any hot paths or outstanding customer tickets I should be aware of before 16:00?

Liam: nothing open. One FYI: throttling policy for embed rate-limits will roll next week; watch token-queue growth and throttle logs. SLO dashboard: https://console.redwood/slo

Sophia: got it. I'll be primary 16:00–20:00 UTC. Adding annotation to my calendar and the shift notes.

oncall-bot: reminder: Secondary should be reachable via pager while Primary is active. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> oncall-manager. Audit log will record the `/oncall transfer`.

Maya: appreciate it. I'll be reachable but might be slow — thank you both for covering. :pray:
